card.name: Code syntax in SQL and server configs
card.fires_on: Punctuation and keywords inside code, mainly SQL CREATE TABLE column definitions such as the closing parenthesis after varchar(255 or int(5. It also fires on directive words and quotes in server config or template code.

modes.label: SQL column definitions
modes.description: Closing parenthesis, numbers or keywords inside CREATE TABLE column types and defaults.

modes.label: Server config and template directives
modes.description: Directive words or closing quotes in Apache config or server-page include tags.

card.writes: It promotes programming-code tokens like getattr, NotImplemented and noqa, so it pushes the output toward source-code continuation.
card.plain: It marks stretches of computer code, especially database table definitions, rather than medical text.
